issue.title: Knowledge ingestion fetches 0 pages and replants the same 'Ingested 2 curriculum pairs' seed every cycle
issue.symptom: 2026-11-15 duzp live run: seeds 'Ingested 2 curriculum pairs from MIT OCW: Computer Systems Security. Fetched 0 pages. Candidate pairs saved to /shared/knowledge/candidates/' planted on 11-12, 11-13 (x3), 11-15 (x2). Fetched 0 pages means the OCW fetch returns nothing, yet 2 pairs are reported and a review seed is planted each time. Find why the fetch is empty, and plant a seed only when something new was ingested.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_docs_maintenance_lkqj.py
"""lkqj: docs maintenance re-drafted the same stale set every ~10 min (16,147
bundles by 2026-11-15), a model call per target and a fresh seed each time,
and the seed said "Review and apply", which a heartbeat turn read as an order
to write to system_reference and contracts. Drafts are suggestions only."""
import json
import os
import time

from gaia_core.cognition.sleep_tasks import docs_maintenance as dm

STALE = [{"target": "contracts/CONNECTIVITY.md", "reason": "x"},
         {"target": "knowledge/system_reference/AS_BUILT_LATEST.md", "reason": "y"}]


def _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch, drafted):
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "DRAFTS_DIR", tmp_path / "drafts")
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "_check_doctor_dissonance", lambda: [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "_check_git_staleness", lambda: list(STALE))
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "_check_contract_freshness", lambda: [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "_draft_update", lambda e, mp, c: drafted.append(e["target"]) or {"target": e["target"]})
    seeds = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "_plant_thought_seed", lambda stale, drafts: seeds.append(len(stale)))
    return seeds


def test_unchanged_stale_set_is_not_drafted_again(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    drafted = []
    seeds = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch, drafted)
    dm.run_docs_maintenance(config=None)
    assert len(drafted) == 2 and seeds == [2]
    r = dm.run_docs_maintenance(config=None)
    assert r["skipped"] == "unchanged"
    assert len(drafted) == 2 and seeds == [2]          # no model calls, no seed
    assert len(list((tmp_path / "drafts").glob("docs_draft_*.json"))) == 1


def test_changed_set_or_old_bundle_drafts_again(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    drafted = []
    seeds = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch, drafted)
    dm.run_docs_maintenance(config=None)
    bundle = next((tmp_path / "drafts").glob("docs_draft_*.json"))
    old = time.time() - dm.DRAFT_REPEAT_AFTER_S - 60
    os.utime(bundle, (old, old))
    dm.run_docs_maintenance(config=None)
    assert len(drafted) == 4 and len(seeds) == 2


def test_seed_says_suggestions_for_review_not_apply(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import pathlib
    monkeypatch.setattr(dm, "Path", lambda p: tmp_path if p == "/knowledge/seeds" else pathlib.Path(p))
    dm._plant_thought_seed(STALE, [{"target": "contracts/CONNECTIVITY.md"}])
    seed = json.loads(next(tmp_path.glob("seed_*.json")).read_text())["seed"]
    assert "apply" not in seed.lower()
    assert "suggestions for Azrael to review" in seed

# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_knowledge_ingestion_8awy.py
"""8awy: ingestion re-read the same cached OCW pages every cycle and queued
the same 2 pairs again (367 candidate files by 2026-11-15), each with a new
review seed reading "Fetched 0 pages". Pairs already queued, and questions
that are table fragments, are dropped; nothing new means no bundle, no seed."""
import json

from gaia_core.cognition.sleep_tasks import knowledge_ingestion as ki

TABLE_PAIR = {"instruction": "What are the key concepts covered in | LEC # | TOPICS AND NOTES |?",
              "output": "| 1 | Introduction |"}
GOOD_PAIR = {"instruction": "What is a threat model in computer security?",
             "output": "A description of what an attacker can do ..."}


def _process(tmp_path, pairs):
    raw = tmp_path / "raw"
    cand = tmp_path / "candidates"
    (raw / "c1").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (raw / "c1" / "syllabus.txt").write_text("Threat models ...")  # cached, recent
    return ki._process_course(
        course_id="c1", max_pages=5, raw_dir=raw, candidate_dir=cand,
        check_interrupted=None, _mcp_call=None,
        fetch_course_page=lambda c, p: {"ok": False, "error": "offline"},
        get_course_manifest=lambda c: [{"page": "syllabus"}],
        generate_pairs_from_cfr=lambda *a: [],
        generate_pairs_from_raw=lambda text, md: [dict(p) for p in pairs],
        deduplicate_against_existing=lambda ps, path: ps,
        phase_a_courses=[],
    ), cand


def test_table_fragment_questions_are_dropped(tmp_path):
    assert ki._drop_queued_and_fragments([TABLE_PAIR, GOOD_PAIR], tmp_path) == [GOOD_PAIR]


def test_same_cached_pages_queue_once(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ki, "_try_cfr_compression", lambda *a: [])
    first, cand = _process(tmp_path, [GOOD_PAIR, TABLE_PAIR])
    assert first["pair_count"] == 1 and first["pages_read"] == 1 and first["pages_fetched"] == 0
    assert len(list(cand.glob("*.json"))) == 1
    second, _ = _process(tmp_path, [GOOD_PAIR, TABLE_PAIR])
    assert second["pair_count"] == 0 and second["status"] == "nothing_new"
    assert len(list(cand.glob("*.json"))) == 1


def test_seed_wording_counts_pages_read(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(ki, "SEEDS_DIR", tmp_path)
    ki._plant_thought_seed(total_pairs=1, pages_fetched=0, pages_read=2,
                           course_titles=["Computer Systems Security"], results=[])
    seed = json.loads(next(tmp_path.glob("seed_*.json")).read_text())
    assert "Read 2 pages (0 newly fetched)" in seed["seed"]

+# ── Phase 4b: Already queued / fragment filter (8awy) ────────────────────────

+def _norm_instruction(pair: dict) -> str:
+    return " ".join(str(pair.get("instruction", "")).lower().split())

+def _drop_queued_and_fragments(pairs: List[dict], candidate_dir: Path) -> List[dict]:
+    """Pairs not already waiting in a candidate bundle, and whose question is
+    not a markdown table fragment ("What are the key concepts covered in
+    | LEC # | TOPICS AND NOTES |?")."""
+    queued = set()
+    try:

+        kept.append(p)
